name: Ralso AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: These blades come in a variety of shapes and styles, but they are typically 2 feet long.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

items.name: Caltrops
items.description:
These four-pronged metal spikes can damage a creature's feet. You can scatter caltrops in an empty square adjacent to you with an Interact action. The first creature that moves into that square must succeed at a @Check[acrobatics|dc:14|name:Avoid Caltrops|showDC:all] check or take @Damage[1d4[piercing]] damage and 1 persistent bleed damage. A creature taking persistent bleed damage from caltrops takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speed. Spending an Interact action to pluck the caltrops free reduces the DC to stop the bleeding. Once a creature takes damage from caltrops, enough are ruined that other creatures moving into the square are safe. Deployed caltrops can be salvaged and reused if no creatures took damage from them. Otherwise, enough are ruined that they can't be salvaged.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Caltrops]

items.name: Ring of Discretion
items.description: This ring magically conceals any armor and sheathed weapons you're wearing by either turning them invisible or creating the illusion of ordinary clothes. The ring doesn't change your appearance beyond concealing weapons and armor. As soon as you wield a weapon, the weapon becomes obvious to onlookers and is no longer affected by the ring until you sheathe the weapon for at least 1 minute. A creature can disbelieve this illusion by Seeking or any time it hits you with an attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Double Stab
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Ralso is wielding two piercing weapons

Frequency once per round

Effect Ralso makes two Strikes against a single creature within reach, one Strike per weapon.

These attacks count toward Ralso's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Ralso deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
